steps.text: I'm presenting today and suddenly my introduction looks unfamiliar 😭
The same one you got through without your notes last night?
Yes. My brain has chosen a very inconvenient time to doubt it
You explained it clearly yesterday
And you answered my questions without having to search through the slides
I know. It's just different with everyone looking at me
Take a second before you start. You don't have to rush into the first sentence
I do rush when I'm nervous
Then keep the cafe example in mind. You knew exactly how to explain that
Okay. Slow down and start with the example
I'd prefer having just you in the audience again
I might be biased
You're very biased. I like it ❤️
I still listened properly
You did. That's why I'm messaging you instead of rewriting the whole thing
Ready. Notes checked, laptop charged, no bags left at your place
Then you're already ahead of yesterday
Please don't remind me of the bag situation 😌
You look good. Now go show them you know your subject
I'll tell you how it goes later
I'll be waiting. Good luck, love ❤️
Thank you. Love you
